text:
alexa: FYI our Vitest run in CI started failing after we moved the SDK build to ESM-only. local Node 20 passes but CI (Node 18) shows "Cannot use import statement outside a module" when tests import the SDK mock.
sam: is CI running vitest or jest? the fix differs.
alexa: Vitest. stack shows require() of ES Module not supported when helper tries to `require('@rw/inference')` from a legacy helper file.
raj: classic. vitest/vite prebundles deps using esbuild and sometimes treats ESM packages badly. try deps.inline in vitest config to force transform: 
```
// vitest.config.ts
export default defineConfig({
  test: { deps: { inline: ['@rw/inference'] } }
})
```
marta: we did inline and it reduced errors but now our vi.mock calls don't override the module — mock file doesn't get applied because the real module executes top-level code before the mock registers.
sam: order matters. vi.mock has to run before the import of the module under test. either call vi.mock() at the very top of the test file (before any imports) or create a manual mock in __mocks__ and import that first.
alexa: for context we have a few legacy Jest tests too. any advice there?
raj: for Jest + ESM use ts-jest preset or babel-jest to transform ESM. example: 
```
// jest.config.cjs
module.exports = {
  preset: 'ts-jest/presets/default-esm',
  transform: { '^.+\\.ts$': 'ts-jest' },
  extensionsToTreatAsEsm: ['.ts'],
  globals: { 'ts-jest': { useESM: true } }
}
```
marta: also check package.json "exports" — CI error "ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED" popped up when tests attempted deep import to dist/internal. that happens if exports map only exposes top-level entry.
alexa: ugh. some test helpers import internals for test-only utilities. we can't publish new exports right now. any workaround?
sam: in monorepo, alias the package to the source directory in vite config so tests resolve to TS source instead of published dist: 
```
resolve: { alias: { '@rw/inference': path.resolve(__dirname, '../packages/sdk/src') } }
```
This avoids exports map and allows vitest to compile TS.
raj: CI sometimes runs tests from within package workspace rather than repo root — adjust alias per-package or use a shared env var that points to the repo root path.
marta: we had flaky failures where sometimes the mock worked and sometimes it didn't. turned out our test setup file was loading polyfills after modules imported fetch. Node 18 in CI doesn't have web streams; edge runtime code expects ReadableStream and fetch.
alexa: what's the minimal polyfill approach?
sam: add a vitest setup file and include before everything: 
```
// test/setup-edge.ts
import 'node-fetch/polyfill'
import { ReadableStream } from 'web-streams-polyfill/ponyfill'
globalThis.ReadableStream = ReadableStream as any
```
and in vitest config: `test.setupFiles: 'test/setup-edge.ts'` so it's applied before any imports.
raj: for mocking fetch we use msw/node in most tests. make sure msw start happens in the setup file too, before tests.
marta: there was also a TS typing mismatch: tests complained there was no default export while runtime import worked (interop). our index.d.ts uses named exports but compiled CJS consumers see default. quick fixes: import * as SDK from '@rw/inference' in tests, or add `esModuleInterop`/`allowSyntheticDefaultImports` in tsconfig for tests. longer-term fix: align types with runtime (`export default` vs named).
alexa: final CI pain: ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED on occasional runs when the package was installed from the workspace link, then node_modules resolution changed (symlink vs hoisted). anyone seen reproducible strategy?
sam: ensure workspace package.json has "main"/"exports" pointing to both cjs and esm entries, or during tests use workspace:protocol alias so vite resolves to source. we opened an internal ticket to add a cjs test target for SDK builds — will help consumers that require() in older tests.
marta: notes: 1) deps.inline for vitest helps 2) make mock registration before imports 3) add setup polyfills for fetch/streams 4) consider source aliasing in CI to avoid exports restrictions 5) ts-jest preset for legacy Jest.
raj: I'll draft a small PR with a vitest config snippet, setup-edge polyfill, and a README blurb for test authors.
devx-bot: Reminder: link to existing issue about test-friendly build targets: https://redwood.company/issue/412 (please reference when filing PR).
alexa: thanks all — creating a follow-up task to standardize SDK test recipes in the devex wiki. marking this thread actionable. :white_check_mark:
